summary: Tested ABI Pricing Through Time app end-to-end. 8/8 backend pytest tests passed (categories seeded with 10, helmets chart-data has 4 items + 5 dates, admin login correct/wrong, protected endpoints enforce X-Admin-Token, create/upsert price points, cascade delete on category and item). Frontend Playwright flow passed for dashboard load, banner image, sidebar (10 cats), tab switching, Tier 5 Ammo & Masks empty state, admin login (wrong+correct password), TestCat add, item add, save snapshot (price-points/bulk), history row update, cascade delete. JonyVole banner href correct and image loads (naturalWidth=1017).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); recommend migrating to lifespan handlers.
Admin auth uses raw password as bearer token in X-Admin-Token; acceptable for single-operator hobby site but should use a session token or hashed compare for stronger posture.
DELETE /categories cascades but is not wrapped in a transaction; if it fails mid-way, orphan items/price_points could remain. Low risk for SQLite-like Mongo single-doc ops here.
PricePointBulkCreate.prices typed as plain dict; consider Dict[str, float] for stricter validation.
slugify can produce duplicate slugs if two categories share normalized names; not enforced uniquely. Add unique index on categories.slug if needed.
test_credentials: Admin password: jonyvole2026 (used as X-Admin-Token header value)
seed_data_creation: Backend self-seeds 10 default categories with sample items/prices for Helmets and Tier 5 Ammo on first startup. Tests create TEST_-prefixed data and clean up via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows verified against external URL. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable. No mocked APIs.
